BrochureContent.Content: Sherry FitzGerald is delighted to present No. 15 Sycamore Road to the market, an impressive double-fronted 1930s residence built by the renowned Kenny Builders, celebrated for their distinctive architectural style and quality craftsmanship. Occupying a prominent position on one of Mount Merrion's most sought-after roads, this elegant family home combines timeless character with exceptional potential, offering spacious accommodation in a highly convenient and desirable setting.Few homes possess such an appealing combination of generous living space, superb gardens and scope for future enhancement. Extending to approximately 42 metres in length, the sun-drenched west-facing rear garden provides an outstanding opportunity to further extend the already substantial accommodation, subject to the necessary planning permissions. The former garage has already been converted into a versatile living space with an adjoining shower room, making it ideal as an additional reception room, home office or ground-floor bedroom.The handsome exterior is immediately recognisable by its attractive façade with bay windows and signature porthole window, features synonymous with the Kenny-built homes of this era. Upon entering, the welcoming entrance hall immediately conveys a wonderful sense of light and space, complemented by the home's impressive ceiling heights. To the right, the dining room and living room offer excellent entertaining and family living space. The dining room enjoys a charming bay window overlooking the front garden, while the living room to the rear features a large picture window and patio doors opening directly onto the sunny west-facing garden. A spacious kitchen overlooks the rear gardens, while a family room, shower room and guest WC complete the accommodation at ground-floor level.Upstairs, a return landing leads to the family bathroom, while the principal landing provides access to the hot press and four generously proportioned bedrooms. An additional store room to the front offers valuable storage space and further flexibility.Sycamore Road is widely regarded as one of Mount Merrion's most desirable addresses, appreciated for its broad tree-lined streets, mature surroundings and peaceful atmosphere. The location is exceptionally convenient for families, with an excellent selection of highly regarded primary and secondary schools nearby, including Coláiste Íosagáin, Coláiste Eoin, Mount Anville, Blackrock College, St. Andrew's College, Oatlands College, and Muckross Park College. UCD Belfield is just minutes away, while Dundrum Town Centre, Stillorgan Shopping Centre and the Merrion Centre provide an extensive range of shopping, dining and leisure amenities. Excellent transport links, including the N11 Quality Bus Corridor, DART and LUAS, ensure swift and easy access to Dublin City Centre and beyond.The gardens at No. 15 are a particularly special feature of this wonderful home. Lovingly maintained over many years, they provide a beautiful and tranquil setting rarely found today. The front garden offers ample off-street parking and is enhanced by mature planting, flowering shrubs and a neatly lawned area. An enclosed side entrance leads to the expansive rear garden, which benefits from a highly desirable west-facing orientation together with an open southerly aspect, creating a true suntrap throughout the day. The mature gardens are beautifully landscaped with generous lawns, colourful planting and an impressive collection of specimen and fruit trees, providing a wonderful outdoor environment for families to enjoy.Offering immense charm, exceptional gardens and outstanding potential in one of South Dublin's most established and desirable residential locations, No. 15 Sycamore Road represents a superb opportunity to put your stamp on a truly special family home. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this exceptional property has to offer.

Entrance Hall - 3.95m x 3.83m
Bright spacious entrance hall with door to understairs storage and step down to lobby.

Dining Room - 4.65m x 3.63m
Fine reception to the front of the house featuring a most attractive bay window, original ceiling coving, fully tiled fireplace and coal effect gas fire inset.

Living room - 5.23m x 4.70m
A lovely bright reception positioned to the rear of the property with picture windows and patio doors to the superb West facing patio and gardens. Original ceiling coving and fully tiled fireplace with coal effect gas fire.

Kitchen / breakfastroom - 3.30m x 4.55m
Positioned to the rear and overlooking the gardens. Range of built in wall and floor units. Mosaic tiled walls. Tiled floor. Gas fired boiler. Door to enclosed side access.

Family room - 2.67 x 2.76m
This space could suit a variety of uses including a playroom, study or ground floor bedroom if required.

Shower room - 
Fully tiled floor and fully tiled walls. WC and pedestal wash hand basin. Corner shower with Myra Event electric shower. Wall mounted mirror and inset lights.

Return Landing - 
Return landing with door to accommodation and stairs to first floor.

Family Bathroom - 2.75m x 2.76m
Good sized bathroom with deep set bath with tiled surround and partly tiled walls. Wc and pedestal wash hand basin. Dado rail. Wall mounted mirror and light. Door to eaves storage.

First floor Landing - 
Bright landing with attic access over and door to hot press.

Bedroom One (front) - 4.70m x 3.63m
Spacious double bedroom with attractive bay window

Bedroom Two (rear) - 3.78m x 3.63m
A second fine double room with built in wardrobes and lovely aspect.

Bedroom 3 (rear) - 2.61m x 2.76m
A third large bedroom, currenlty laid out as a study with wonderful views of the rear garden.

Bedroom Four (rear) - 3.78m x 2.76m
A fourth sunny bedroom with an enviable aspect.

Store room - 
A good sized storage room with Porthole window. These spaces have been used, in other properties we have sold, by buyers to extend the front bedroom and provide the opportunity for an ensuite, walk in wardrobe or can be part of a larger extension on the first floor level depending on a buyers needs.

Outside - 
The wonderful mature gardens are a major feature in this home. The front provides ample off street parking and a mature lawn surrounded by mature plants and shrubs. There is a gated enclosed side access that provides access to the kitchen and to the rear garden.The rear garden accessed via the side access and directly from the living room is a wonderful feature. Totalling approx. 42m in length the gardens are mostly laid out in lawn but also have been well cared for by the current owners. There is a n attractive patio area to make the most of the south and west aspects. The borders are well planted with a host of flowering plants and shrubs. The garden also features a wonderful mature apple trees, This wonderful garden provides plenty of space to extend the accommodation if desired whilst retaining a wonderful family sized garden.
